label.en: We believe [alternate_planet.GetName] would be a much better test bed!

texts.zh:
[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]已经完成了对[root.GetName]的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。

在整个星球上，当地的昆虫现在开始使用与我们无线设备相同的频率进行通信。一声虫鸣就能操作自动门，成群的虫群甚至能使一座工厂瘫痪。我们正在通过切换频率来应对，但并非所有设施都能恢复到完全效率。
texts.en:
The [fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName] has completed its modifications on [root.GetName]. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

Planetwide, the local insects now communicate using the same frequencies as our wireless devices. A single chirp can operate an automatic door, and a swarm can incapacitate a factory. We are adapting by switching frequencies, but not all facilities will be returned to full efficiency.

texts.zh:
[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]已经完成了对[root.GetName]的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。

在整个星球上，那些曾经只知道吃草和泥浴的生物现在开始向我们提出关于存在本质的令人不安的问题。失落帝国改变了这个世界上大量野生动物的天性。
texts.en:
The [fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName] has completed its modifications on [root.GetName]. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

Planetwide, creatures once content with grazing and mud baths now confront us with unsettling questions about existence. The Fallen Empire has tampered with large swathes of the world's fauna.

texts.zh:
[fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName]已经完成了对[root.GetName]的改造。虽然他们的影响是无形的，但效果却是不可否认的。

这个世界在发光。字面意思的发光。这些改造不知何故让世界上各种物种都具有了生物荧光，并且不断发出类似引擎运转的嗡鸣声。我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]再也无法体验真正的昼夜循环了，我们需要为他们提供遮光设备。
texts.en:
The [fallen_empire_hive_growth.GetName] has completed its modifications on [root.GetName]. Their influence was unseen, but the effects are undeniable.

The world is shining. Literally. The modifications have somehow provided the world's varied species with a bioluminescent glow and an incessant hum like that of a running engine. Our [owner.GetColonistPlural] no longer get to experience a true night cycle, we will need to provide them with blackout equipment.

label.zh: 这完全不能接受，清除所有昆虫！
label.en: This is unacceptable, remove every insect!

label.zh: 更新受到干扰。清除这些虫子。

label.en: What a terrible day to have [owner.GetEyeNamePlural].

label.zh: 把它们遮起来，砍掉它们。我们不能让这种情况继续下去！
label.en: Cover them up, chop them down. We can't let this continue!

texts.zh:
今天就是你们这些脆弱的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]证明自己的日子！我们培育出了一种新型生物舰船。这个品系已经通过屠杀其他同窝幼体证明了自己的实力，现在是时候让它对抗一些异族生物了。一个实验体将会在适当的时候抵达[target_system.GetName]。

努力为我们提供一些有趣的数据吧。
texts.en:
Today is the day you fragile [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] prove yourselves! We have a new breed of biological ship. The strain has already proven itself by decimating its fellow hatchlings and the time has come to test it against something alien. A specimen will be arriving in [target_system.GetName] in due course.

Endeavor to provide us with some interesting data.

label.zh: 这才是值得一战的挑战！

texts.zh:
我们看到那个实验品还活着。你们还是太弱了。

也许我们应该派一只变形虫来的。
texts.en:
We see that the experimental breed still lives. You are still too weak.

Perhaps we should have sent an amoeba.

texts.zh:
精彩。我们很高兴看到你们注意到了这个品系偏好闪避火力的特点，并恰当地加以利用。请放心，等到下一代完成孕育时，它就不会再有这个缺陷了。

你们已经成长了，年轻的[root.GetSpeciesName]。做好准备吧。
texts.en:
Glorious. We are pleased that you noted the preference this breed had for dodging fire and exploited it properly. Be assured that it won't have that fault by the time the next generation finishes gestating.

You have grown young [root.GetSpeciesName]. Be prepared.

texts.zh:
我们注意到你们目前并未参与任何战斗。为什么？年轻的帝国必须战斗，否则就会落后。我们已经为你们选好了对手，[unfortunate_country.GetName]。在十年内击败他们，你们的持续发展就有保障了。

别担心你们之间的停战协定。它已经不存在了。
texts.en:
We have noticed that you are not currently engaged in battle. Why? Young empires must fight or fall behind. We have selected an opponent for you, the [unfortunate_country.GetName]. Defeat them within a decade and your continued development will be assured.

And do not worry about the truce you have with them. It is gone.

texts.zh: 我们注意到你们目前并未参与任何战斗。为什么？年轻的帝国必须战斗，否则就会落后。我们已经为你们选好了对手，[unfortunate_country.GetName]。在十年内击败他们，你们的持续发展就有保障了。
texts.en: We have noticed that you are not currently engaged in battle. Why? Young empires must fight or fall behind. We have selected an opponent for you, the [unfortunate_country.GetName]. Defeat them within a decade and your continued development will be assured.

label.zh: 冲突不是进步的唯一途径！
label.en: Conflict is not the only means of progress!

texts.zh:
年轻的[Root.GetName]，我们带来一个警告，以及一个挑战。

虽然掠夺周遭一切的感觉令人陶醉，但要想真正理解战争，你们也必须懂得和平。

花上十年时间好好思考你们已经获得的一切。相信我们：休息一下，否则你们会崩溃的。
texts.en:
Young [Root.GetName], we come with a warning, and a challenge.

While it can be intoxicating, grabbing all that is around you, to truly know War you must also know Peace.

Take a decade to reflect on what you have gained. Trust us: rest, or you will break.

texts.zh:
你们的生物质派送迟到了。但不...你们并不是[targetrivalname.GetName]。

为什么要打扰我们？

啊，对了。你们将接收一个长期休眠的模式，是一个经过数千年精心保存的基因组。我们一直在等待最佳时机来释放它。你们在[target_planet.GetName]上的殖民地是理想的接收地。它的生物圈很快就会被同化。
texts.en:
Your biomass dispatch is late. But no... you are not the [targetrivalname.GetName].

Why did you distract us?

Ah, yes. You are to be the recipient of a long dormant pattern, a genome stored with care for millennia. We have delayed release until the moment was ripe. Your colony on [target_planet.GetName] - it is the ideal recipient. Its biosphere will be subsumed momentarily.

label.zh: 我们认为[alternate_planet.GetName]会是个更好的试验场！
label.en: We believe [alternate_planet.GetName] would be a much better test bed!

label.zh: 多么荒谬的要求，我们拒绝！
label.en: What an absurd demand, we refuse!

texts.zh:
生活在你们境内的[boring_species.GetName]物种简单到令人失望，他们的存在仿佛行尸走肉。这种迟钝的生物伤害了我们的集体意志。我们将提供三种不同的方法来纠正这种……失败。

不要让我们感到无聊。
texts.en:
The [boring_species.GetName] species living within your borders has proven to be disappointingly simple, their existence a hollow echo of potential. Such stagnation offends our collective will. We will grant one of three different methods to rectify this... failure.

Do not bore us.

label.zh: 我们不会一直保持现状。
label.en: We wont stay the same for long.

label.zh: 我们不会因你的一时兴起就改变一个物种！
label.en: We won't change a species on your whim!

texts.zh: 我们观察到，你们种族中的个别个体发展出了一种我们巨大的基因库中都没有的特殊特质。你要提供给我们的不只是分析报告。我们需要这种[fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]的活体样品，不要惊慌。不需要一整格[interesting_species.GetName]。只要一只[interesting_species.GetHandName]就能培养一个替代品。
texts.en: We have observed that certain of your kind have developed a peculiar trait absent from our vast genetic repository. You will provide us with more than an analysis. We require a living sample of this [fallen_empire_hive_growth.species.GetInterestingTraitName]. Do not be alarmed. A complete [interesting_species.GetName] is not necessary. A [interesting_species.GetHandName] will suffice to cultivate a replacement.

label.zh: 在宏大的计划面前，一只[interesting_species.GetHandName]算得了什么？
label.en: What is a single [interesting_species.GetHandName] in the grand scheme of things?

label.zh: 我们不能让你染指我们的基因构造！
label.en: You cannot be trusted with our genetic makeup!

texts.zh:
这是一则预先录制的信息。请勿尝试回复。

我们已调整此通讯以便你理解。已考虑到你们有限的语言能力。必须立即上缴一个[target_pop.GetSpeciesName]用于同化。他们的异常不能容忍。绝不容忍。

运输船已在[target_pop.Planet.GetName]外待命。时间紧迫。拒绝配合将危及稳定。
texts.en:
This is a pre-recorded message. Do not attempt to reply.

We have altered this communication for your understanding. Your limited language has been accounted for. A [target_pop.GetSpeciesName] must be surrendered immediately for assimilation. Their deviance can not be tolerated. Will not be tolerated.

The transport is already positioned outside [target_pop.Planet.GetName]. Time is against you. Failure to comply jeopardizes stability.

label.en: You will have to take them from us!

texts.zh:
我们接通了来自[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]的通讯。然而，向我们打招呼的不是=古老的[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName]而是一位熟悉的[target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName]。

今天对你们来说是个转折点。你们物种的基因序列已经得到保障——已被同化入整体。你们的未来不再充满不确定。当时机来临时，你们将成为我们的一部分。
texts.en:
We accepted the communication from [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. However, rather than an ancient [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName] we were greeted with a familiar [target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName].

Today marks a pivotal moment for you. Your species' genetic sequence has been secured - assimilated into the whole. Your future is no longer uncertain. When the time comes, you will be part of us.

label.zh: 原来我们也会让其他人有这种感受吗？
label.en: Is that how we make others feel?

texts.zh:
我们接通了来自[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]的通讯。然而，向我们打招呼的不是=古老的[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName]而是一位熟悉的[target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName]。

时间不多了。他们在[fallen_empire_hive_control.Capital.GetName]对我们进行的实验简直难以形容，这种事甚至不该在最凶恶的敌人身上施行。我希望这个数据包中的内容能确保这个碎片永远无法控制我们。
texts.en:
We accepted the communication from [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]. However, rather than an ancient [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetSpeciesName] we were greeted with a familiar [target_leader_fe_control.Species.GetName].

There is not much time. The experiments they have been running on us here on [fallen_empire_hive_control.Capital.GetName] are undescribable, and shouldn't be done to our worst enemies. I hope what's in this data packet ensures that this fragment never gains control of us.

label.en: It's a trap! End the transmission!

texts.zh:
你们为什么还要用如此无能的扩张继续玷污星河？看来是所有人都因为太过厌恶而不愿告诉你们，所以我们来说：没人喜欢你们的边境，如果你们不在这片星域，一切都会好得多。

[offending_system.GetName]恒星系既不实用又不和谐。为了星系的团结，你们必须立即从你们的帝国中清除它。
texts.en:
Why must you continue blighting the galaxy with your incompetent expansions? Everyone must be too repulsed to tell you so we'll say it: nobody likes your borders and space would be vastly improved if you were not in it.

The [offending_system.GetName] system is impractical and discordant. You must purge it from your Empire now for the sake of galactic cohesion.

label.zh: 你们想让我们放弃一个恒星系就为了美化边境？！
label.en: You want us to abandon a system to prettify our borders?!
But we like it like this!

texts.zh:
装疯卖傻？你们只需要放弃[offending_system.GetName]恒星系就够了。

也许我们应该更积极地收拾你们。
texts.en:
Are you being deliberately ignorant? All you needed to do was rid yourself of the [offending_system.GetName] system.

Perhaps we should take a more active role in pruning you.

texts.zh:
总算开窍了。[FromFrom.GetName]星系的事就此揭过。看来你们还有救，或许有朝一日能达到我们的境界。

我们会一直盯着你们的。
texts.en:
It is good to see you learning from your past mistakes, finally. Consider the [FromFrom.GetName] system issue now resolved. There is hope yet that you may become more like us.

We will be watching.
